name: Sample 4: American senior engineer
reference_text: The service accepts requests through a local interface. Each request is validated before it enters the processing queue. If a worker fails, the request is marked as failed and the service remains available. The next request starts a new worker.
description: A man in his late fifties with a deep, mature baritone voice. He is a native speaker of United States English who grew up in the American Midwest. Use a natural standard General American accent throughout: fully rhotic, with clearly pronounced R sounds in words such as service, worker, and marked, and natural American vowels. He is an experienced American engineer reading a technical document to a colleague. His delivery is dry, composed, and matter-of-fact, with a low habitual pitch, small pitch variations, and steady moderate pacing. Clear consonants and natural pauses at sentence boundaries. No enthusiasm, smiling tone, promotional delivery, dramatic emphasis, or upward inflection.
